endpoints.notes: Re-verified live 2026-08-29 (was stamped unreachable 2026-06-06 with no probe record, and the flag was wrong at least by 2026-08-29): the enrich-shape query (point + 30 m, OWNERNAME1/OWNERADDRESS/PROPERTYADDRESS/PPN) at Grand Rapids City Hall answered in 0.8 s with owner names and mailing addresses; where=1=1 count 232,036. Values are space-padded (trim before matching).

counties.notes: Kent County (Grand Rapids metro) hosts ParcelsWithCondos/MapServer/0, a countywide parcel layer including condominium units. 22 fields: PPN, TAXPARCEL_FLAG, OWNERNAME1, OWNERNAME2, OWNERCAREOF, OWNERADDRESS, OWNERCITY, OWNERZIPCODE, PROPERTYADDRESS, PROPADDRESSCITY, PROPADDRESSSTATE_ZIPCODE, PROPERTYCLASS, GOVERNMENTALUNIT, SCHOOLDISTRICT, SEV/TAXABLE fields (2 tribunals), ACREAGE, PNUM, geometry. Query confirmed live: UPPER(OWNERNAME1) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real owner names. Owner mailing address is in OWNERADDRESS/OWNERCITY/OWNERZIPCODE. The county's open data hub at kentcountymi-accesskent.opendata.arcgis.com mirrors the same data. Michigan parcel ID (PPN) format is 10-digit county-township-parcel. INFRASTRUCTURE OUTAGE (verified 2026-06-06): the entire agisprod ArcGIS server is offline ('Could not access any server machines') -- every service and the portal are affected. Looks transient rather than a retirement; recheck around 2026-07-06.

ownerFieldNote.body: Oakland County's public parcel layer documents NAME1 and NAME2 as owner columns, but neither is populated on the public service: a live sample of 300 records returned no value in either, so no query can retrieve ownership here. The service publishes no stated reason. Key PIN, parcel identification number, site address, site city and property class code are populated and searchable. Ownership is available from the county directly.

counties.notes: Oakland County (Detroit metro NW, county seat Pontiac) serves 332k+ parcels via EnterpriseOpenParcelDataMapService/MapServer/1 (branded 'Tax Parcel Plus'). The public layer exposes PIN, KEYPIN, SITEADDRESS, SITECITY, SITESTATE, SITEZIP5, POSTALADDRESS, CLASSCODE, CVTTAXCODE, CVTTAXDESCRIPTION, ASSESSEDVALUE, TAXABLEVALUE, STRUCTURE_DESC, LIVING_AREA_SQFT, NUM_BEDS, NUM_BATHS. OWNER NAME REDACTED: NAME1 and NAME2 fields are present in the schema but return null in all public query results as of 2026-05-15. Full owner data is available only through the fee-based Property Gateway at gis.oakgov.com/PropertyGateway/. The public Access Oakland portal (accessoakland.oakgov.com) hosts the same OC Tax Parcels (Public) dataset. PIN format is 10-digit Michigan standard. For parcel-boundary-only use cases (without owner), this endpoint is fully functional.

basis.note: Oakland County's public parcel layer documents NAME1 and NAME2 as owner columns, but neither carries a value in any record sampled, so no query can return ownership here. The service states no reason.

counties.notes: Countywide parcel layer covering all of Wayne County, not Detroit alone: 768,119 parcels across 125 distinct propcity values including Livonia, Dearborn, Canton, Westland, Taylor, Redford and the Grosse Pointes. Owner names are populated on 744,052 rows (96.9 percent) and are real individuals, verified outside Detroit. Six usable columns: packedParc, ownername1, propstreet, propcity, propstate, propzip. There is no mailing-address column. Caveat for anyone filtering on it: propcity is dirty, carrying misspellings such as DETRIOT and GARDEN CTIY and a handful of rows where an owner name leaked into the city column. Spatial lookup is unaffected.

Tax parcel layer at layer index 10 of the Macomb County Parcel Data service, not layer 0. 332,971 parcels with owner names on 331,114 rows (99.4 percent), real individuals. Columns: TAX_ID, ownername1, propstreetcombined, propertyCityStateZip, CVT_NAME, zoning. No mailing address. The service metadata reports wkid null, which normally signals a projection problem, but the buffered spatial query answers correctly and was verified against a live address; the null is a metadata quirk rather than a broken layer.

contact.department: Lenawee County Equalization Department, GIS Division

counties.notes: Lenawee County (county seat Adrian) publishes its countywide parcels as layer 2 'Lenawee Parcels' of the hosted feature service Lenawee_Parcels_Public. The layer carries TAXID, the dashed Michigan parcel number (for example RG0-109-4150-00), and its packed form PACKPARNUM; owner names OWNNM1 and OWNNM2; and the property (situs) address in PRADDCOMB with its components PRADDRNUM, PRADDRSTR, PRADDRCITY and PRADDRZIP. There is no owner mailing-address field. LIBERPAGE is the deed liber and page, and BSALink is a per-parcel link into the county's BS&A Online record for deed and tax detail. Re-verified 2026-09-26: the layer holds 55,211 parcels and an UPPER(OWNNM1) LIKE '%SMITH%' query returned live owner rows. CORS is open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). The layer's item page carries the county's standard disclaimer that the map is for reference only and is not a legal description.

Iron County, Michigan (Crystal Falls and Iron River; FIPS 26071) has no public ArcGIS REST service with owner names as of 2026-11-10. The county's Equalization Department links a Colligo GIS viewer, which is a proprietary web map with no query service, and the only Iron County parcel layer on ArcGIS Online, 'Parcels - MI - Iron County' (last modified 2022-07-27), answers 'Token Required'. No statewide public parcel layer with owner names was found as of 2026-11-10. Parcel and tax records can be searched through the county's BS&A Online portal, which returns no geometry and offers no field-level API, and through the Equalization Department's viewer. Two same-name ArcGIS parcel applications belong to other states and do not cover this county: Iron County, Utah's and Iron County, Missouri's.

coverage.summary: Iron County, Michigan shows parcels in a Colligo viewer and has no public query service with owner names, so we don't index it. Use the county's viewer or its BS&A Online portal, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: No public ArcGIS REST parcel layer with owner names was found for Alcona County, Michigan (county seat Harrisville; FIPS 26001) as of 2026-11-01. The county website's GIS Property Maps link opens a Schneider Beacon application (beacon.schneidercorp.com, AppID 1164), which answered a scripted request with a bot-check page, and its Equalization page links BS&A Online for assessing records; neither is a query service we can use. No statewide public parcel layer with owner names was found as of 2026-11-10. ArcGIS Online searches for Alcona parcels found a 2021 parcel layer covering Alcona Township only, a 2023 third-party copy in an aggregator's schema on a university account, and county broadband and boundary layers without parcels; none is a county parcel source. The same search shape finds Lenawee County's own parcel layer, registered in this file, so the absence is meaningful. Owner and tax records can be looked up on the county's Beacon map or BS&A Online, or by asking the Equalization Department. Re-check if the county publishes a public parcel service.

coverage.summary: Alcona County shows parcels only on its Beacon map and BS&A Online, which have no public query service we can use, so we don't index it. Use the county's Beacon map, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Shiawassee County, Michigan (Corunna; FIPS 26155) sells its parcel data and publishes no public ArcGIS REST service as of 2026-11-10. The county's GIS page offers a Fetch GIS web viewer, and its board-approved GIS pricing sheet lists parcel data at $7,500 for the entire county, with the condition that "Reproduction and/or redistribution of the data provided by Shiawassee County is prohibited without the express written consent of Shiawassee County." Because that term requires written consent before the data is passed on, this atlas does not index Shiawassee County. The county's viewer shows parcels, and the county's Drain Office and GIS sell the parcel data.

coverage.summary: Shiawassee County sells its parcel data and prohibits redistribution without its written consent, so we don't index it. Use the county's Fetch GIS viewer, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Muskegon County, Michigan (Muskegon, Norton Shores, Muskegon Heights; FIPS 26121). Served by the county's own ArcGIS Server at maps.muskegoncountygis.com, PropertyViewer MapServer layer 25 'Parcels - LS' (layers 23 and 24 draw the same parcels at other scales), which carries the Equalization Department's assessment data. Read as of 2026-11-10: 84,809 parcels; Owner_Name1 non-blank on 84,800, Owner_Address on 84,476, Property_Address_Combined (site) on 84,192; UPPER(Owner_Name1) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 745, the sample query's predicate. The owner mailing address is Owner_Address with Owner_Address_City, Owner_Address_State and Owner_Address_ZipCode; Owner_CareOf holds a care-of line. Capabilities Map, Query and Data, maxRecordCount 1000 with pagination, native WKID 2253 (Michigan State Plane South, feet), and the server reflects the caller's Origin for CORS. The Parcels_Public and Equalization folders on the same server need a token and are not used. EXEMPTION COLUMN, NOT LISTED: PRE_Homestead_Pct is the principal-residence exemption percentage. Clause 5 requires this disclaimer in the use agreement of any application of the Data, and it is in UrbanKit's Terms of Service, section 4: "The Licensee agrees that the County and its elected officials, employees, and agents shall not be liable for damages of any kind (including, but not limited to, loss of use, time or data, inconvenience, commercial loss, business interruption, lost profits or savings, or the cost of computer equipment and software) arising from the use of the Data or any application that uses the Data including, but not limited to, direct, indirect, incidental, punitive and consequential, or special damages."
